scope: Source-file indexing through /v2/code/index or workspace scan; external SCIP ingestion is a separate API path.
limitations: SCIP is imported through /v2/code/index/scip, not generated by these source parsers; external indexer quality varies.
Go parser uses AST syntax, not whole-package go/types resolution; static_analysis does not imply type-resolved calls.
Tree-sitter declarations and called names are syntax evidence, not resolved target identities; ambiguous calls must not create guessed edges.

JSX and TSX extensions are recognized by workspace scan, but the installed grammars are JavaScript and TypeScript, not dedicated JSX/TSX grammars. JSX/TSX parsing is not qualified and may fall back to file-only evidence.
The offline Git worklist supports a narrower extension set than workspace scan; see scripts/scos_git_worklist.py.
SQL, YAML and configuration files receive file-level path-convention evidence only.
Syntax errors fall back to file-only evidence; no source parser silently upgrades its confidence to deterministic SCIP.
